[font=Comic Sans MS][center]【About this mod】[/center]
[list]
[*][u]What it offers[/u]  Some furniture trees recolor for [color=#6aa84f][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿ [/color]
[/list][/font][font=Comic Sans MS]        (Seasonal) Fruit Trees ; (Seasonal) Trees ; Mushroom Trees ; Desert Trees﻿[/font]  
[font=Comic Sans MS] [/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][u]How can I use it[/u]  ﻿[/font][font=Comic Sans MS]Download the file directly and place it in the mod folder.﻿﻿If you need to use these assets, you should either go to Robin's shop and buy the catalogue, or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ and turn on all the cheat options so you don't have to buy the catalogue and use them.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]   [/font]       [*][font=Comic Sans MS][u]Tips [/u] ﻿[/font][font=Comic Sans MS]The .json files have been re-edited due to the size of the maps being different from those in the original folder, so please don't replace them directly ![/font]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][u][b]﻿[/b][/u][u][b]P.S[/b][/u]    ﻿[/font]If you're interested, here's a very nice [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22954]furniture tree[/url]﻿ mod by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NanoIsNotRobot?gameId=1303]Nano[/url]﻿.
[/list]
